# testing_oas_pattern (Data Source)

OASPattern DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_oas_pattern" "my_oaspattern" {
  id = "...my_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `complex_pattern` (String) complex pattern compilation (^.?([a-z]*|A+|\s|`)$)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `incompatible_pattern` (String) RE2 incompatible pattern should be skipped
- `invalid_pattern` (String) invalid pattern should be skipped
- `oneof_request` (String) oneOf request only patterns (union of request1 and request1)
- `oneof_request_and_response` (String) <- oneOf request and response patterns (union of request_and_response1 and request_and_response2)
- `oneof_response` (String) oneOf response only patterns (union of response1 and response2)
- `request` (String) request only pattern (request)
- `request_and_response` (String) request and response pattern (both request_and_response)
- `response` (String) response only pattern (response)
